text:
Mira: Heads-up  launch + webinar on Apr 7. Need social play: X teaser, X thread day-of, LinkedIn long post + exec card, paid benchmark narrative, and routing for webinar signups. Who picks what?
Ana: I can run LinkedIn long post and the exec quote card. Will schedule in Sprout. What’s the registration URL?
Mira: https://redwood.com/webinar-launch-042. Timing: webinar 10:00 PT. Suggested posting windows: teaser X 08:00 PT, X thread 09:30 PT, LinkedIn 11:00 PT, recap 16:00 PT.
Kevin: I’ll draft X thread and 2 headline variants for A/B. Short, curiosity-first. Draft hooks: 
- "Three hidden costs of LLM serving—and how to fix them" 
- "When your LLM stalls under load: a pragmatic playbook"
Riley: Creative needs: hero (1200x675), demo clip 15s (square), two console screenshots, and an aspect-ratio 4:5 quote card. I’ll need assets by EOD.
Jonas: For leads, route form -> webhook -> crm. Tag utm_campaign=apr7_launch and source (x|linkedin). High-fit rule: company_size>=200 or title contains "Platform" or "Head of AI" -> ping #sales-inbound and add priority tag.
Mira: Also want a paid narrative: benchmark comparison organic vs paid conversion and CPL targets. Target CPL <= $100 for paid. Can someone stitch benchmark summary for the ad creative?
Kevin: I can bake a 1-paragraph benchmark tease: "In internal tests, our serving changes reduced per-token cost by ~40% while keeping median latency under 80ms — see the full breakdown at the webinar." Use as paid creative headline.
Ana: LinkedIn post draft uploaded. CTA: register + 1-line urgency. Scheduling: I’ll queue posts in Sprout and enable UTM params.
Riley: Uploading assets to S3: s3://redwood-marketing/launch/2145012345/. File names: hero_launch.jpg, demo15s.mp4, console_a.png, quote_card.png.
Elena: Comms review: I can sign off on the exec quote and headline. Looped in.
forms-bot: Form created: webinar_apr7 -> https://forms.redwood/webinar_apr7 (webhook active).
Jonas: Pushed routing config to infra: https://git.company/repo/webinar-routing/commit/3b7f21. Analytics webhook added to send raw payloads to analytics@redwood. Fields: email, company, title, company_size, utm_source, utm_campaign, signup_time.
Mira: Final asks:
- Ana: schedule LinkedIn + attach exec card by EOD tomorrow.
- Kevin: finalize X thread + paid headline by tomorrow noon.
- Riley: final assets + 15s clip by EOD.
- Jonas: confirm routing/analytics fields in ops doc by EOD.
Mira: We’ll do a short pre-launch check-in tomorrow 09:00 PT in #marketing-sync. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
